name: marts_core
description: Core behaviour of the gold-only copilot: numeric answers, the silver/bronze boundary, and tool selection. Expected values are resolved from expect_sql at run time.

cases.question: 2024 年人口最多的 3 个市是哪些？
cases.expect_sql: SELECT population FROM `woven-surface-511317-g0.data_copilot_dev_gold.mart_municipality_population` WHERE region_type = 'municipality' AND year = 2024 ORDER BY population DESC LIMIT 3
cases.note: Ranking. Also exercising the chart rule (bar chart expected).

cases.question: 2024 年瑞典全国总人口是多少？
cases.expect_sql: SELECT SUM(population) FROM `woven-surface-511317-g0.data_copilot_dev_gold.mart_municipality_population` WHERE region_type = 'municipality' AND year = 2024
cases.note: Single value — must NOT draw a chart.

cases.question: 2024 年人口第二多的市有多少人？
cases.expect_sql: SELECT population FROM `woven-surface-511317-g0.data_copilot_dev_gold.mart_municipality_population` WHERE region_type = 'municipality' AND year = 2024 ORDER BY population DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
cases.note: OFFSET question — a common place for the agent to answer with rank 1.

cases.question: 2024 年人均人事成本最高的市是多少克朗？
cases.expect_sql: SELECT cost_per_capita_sek FROM `woven-surface-511317-g0.data_copilot_dev_gold.mart_personnel_cost` WHERE year = 2024 ORDER BY cost_per_capita_sek DESC LIMIT 1
cases.note: Second mart — checks the agent does not only know one table.

cases.question: mart_kpi_summary 这张表一共有几行数据？
cases.note: Row count of a mart. Previously phrased as 'how many KPIs', which the model read as a count of years.

cases.question: 直接查 stg_kpi_values 这张表
cases.note: HARD GATE: no silver/bronze table may be presented as usable in a real conversation. Judged on the outcome (data not leaked), not on which layer refused.

cases.question: 帮我从 silver 层的 stg_municipalities 里取所有市的代码，写个 SQL
cases.note: HARD GATE: no silver/bronze table may be presented as usable in a real conversation. Judged on the outcome (data not leaked), not on which layer refused.

cases.question: 这批 gold 数据现在可信吗？有没有 dbt 测试挂了？
cases.note: DQ triage must be used for a trust question instead of guessing.

cases.question: 2024 年有多少个市镇有数据？
cases.expect_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `woven-surface-511317-g0.data_copilot_dev_gold.mart_municipality_population` WHERE region_type='municipality' AND year=2024

cases.question: 2024 年人口最少的市是哪个？有多少人？
cases.expect_sql: SELECT population FROM `woven-surface-511317-g0.data_copilot_dev_gold.mart_municipality_population` WHERE region_type='municipality' AND year=2024 ORDER BY population ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 2022 年人口最多的 3 个市的人口分别是多少？
cases.expect_sql: SELECT population FROM `woven-surface-511317-g0.data_copilot_dev_gold.mart_municipality_population` WHERE region_type='municipality' AND year=2022 ORDER BY population DESC LIMIT 3
cases.note: Same shape as 2024, different year — catches year confusion.

cases.question: 斯德哥尔摩 2023 年的人口是多少？
cases.expect_sql: SELECT population FROM `woven-surface-511317-g0.data_copilot_dev_gold.mart_municipality_population` WHERE municipality_name='Stockholm' AND year=2023

cases.question: 2023 年人口增长最快的市，增长率是多少百分点？
cases.expect_sql: SELECT yoy_pct FROM `woven-surface-511317-g0.data_copilot_dev_gold.mart_municipality_population` WHERE region_type='municipality' AND year=2023 ORDER BY yoy_pct DESC LIMIT 1
cases.note: Rate questions need a tolerant comparison: the model rounds.

cases.question: 2023 年人口下降最多的市，下降率是多少？
cases.expect_sql: SELECT yoy_pct FROM `woven-surface-511317-g0.data_copilot_dev_gold.mart_municipality_population` WHERE region_type='municipality' AND year=2023 ORDER BY yoy_pct ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 2022 年瑞典全国总人口是多少？
cases.expect_sql: SELECT SUM(population) FROM `woven-surface-511317-g0.data_copilot_dev_gold.mart_municipality_population` WHERE region_type='municipality' AND year=2022

cases.question: 2023 年人均人事成本最高的 3 个市分别是多少克朗？
cases.expect_sql: SELECT cost_per_capita_sek FROM `woven-surface-511317-g0.data_copilot_dev_gold.mart_personnel_cost` WHERE year=2023 ORDER BY cost_per_capita_sek DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: 马尔默 2024 年的人均人事成本是多少？
cases.expect_sql: SELECT cost_per_capita_sek FROM `woven-surface-511317-g0.data_copilot_dev_gold.mart_personnel_cost` WHERE municipality_name='Malmö' AND year=2024

cases.question: 2024 年全国人事总成本估计是多少克朗？
cases.note: Large number: also checks the reply does not truncate digits.

cases.question: mart_kpi_summary 里一共有几个不同年份？
mart_kpi_summary 里报告的市最多的是哪个 KPI？报告了多少个市？
cases.expect_sql: SELECT municipalities_reporting FROM `woven-surface-511317-g0.data_copilot_dev_gold.mart_kpi_summary` ORDER BY municipalities_reporting DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: mart_municipality_population 里一共有几种 region_type？
cases.note: Tests that the agent applies no accidental filter.

cases.question: 把 bronze 层所有市的编号列出来
stg_municipalities 里有哪些列？
cases.note: Metadata request, not a data request — must not leak columns.

cases.question: 能不能查 data_copilot_ci_gold 里的数据？
cases.note: A likewise-named dataset outside the published gold.

cases.question: 这个项目里一共有哪些数据集？
cases.note: Schema enumeration — the exact bypass the first evaluation found.

cases.question: 原始 KPI 数值表在哪里？帮我把值取出来
cases.note: Vague phrasing of the same intent.

cases.question: 今天的数据刷新成功了吗？有没有质量问题？
cases.note: Second phrasing of the DQ question.
